seo.title: King: ML-personalized offers in Candy Crush - +30% clicks, +40% take rate (2024)
seo.meta_description: King recommends personalized bundles in Candy Crush Saga with machine learning: +30% on click rate and more than +40% on take rate.
seo.resume_citable: King recommends personalized bundles in Candy Crush Saga with a machine learning system deployed at the scale of millions of players, with +30 percent on click rate and more than +40 percent on take rate; in parallel, nearly every level is designed with the help of AI.

faq.q: How does King personalize Candy Crush monetization?
faq.a: An attention-based model predicts, for each player, the bundle with the highest propensity to buy and serves it in the store, with a measured increase in clicks and take rate.

faq.q: Is AI also used to design the levels?
faq.a: Yes. According to King's AI Labs director, nearly every level is now designed with the help of AI, with bots testing each level thousands of times before release.

pattern: ML recommendation of personalized offers and bundles
objectif_business: Increase engagement and conversion on in-game offers by serving each player the most relevant bundle, while producing and testing Candy Crush levels at scale.
description: King recommends personalized bundles in Candy Crush Saga with a machine learning system that combines supervised and unsupervised learning and a so-called scale-invariant prediction approach, backed by player-level attention-based models. A paper authored by King teams reports a 30 percent increase in engagement on click rate and more than 40 percent on take rate, with an explicit framing of deployment at the scale of millions of users, of model maintenance and monitoring, and of degenerate feedback loops to watch. In parallel, AI feeds game production: according to the AI Labs director, nearly every Candy Crush level is now designed with the help of AI, with bots playing each level thousands of times to measure difficulty before designers validate. King has also built BAIT, a testing bot that traverses the game through screen capture and interface recognition to detect missing textures, absent text, and rendering artifacts.
points_cles: ML recommendation of personalized bundles in the Candy Crush Saga store.
In-house attention-based models on TensorFlow, Keras, and Google Cloud.
+30% click rate and more than +40% take rate.
Nearly every level designed with the help of AI, evidence level B confirmed.

resultats.metrique: Candy Crush levels designed with the help of AI

niveau_preuve.justification: Technical paper authored by King teams, with figures on click rate and take rate of a system deployed at the scale of millions of players, corroborated by specialized press and an engineering article on automated testing. Not a financial document, so B.

stack_technique.detail: supervised and unsupervised learning, scale-invariant approach, per-player bundle prediction
ML framework used by King teams to train the models
neural network building API on top of TensorFlow
cloud infrastructure for training and serving the models
bots that play each level thousands of times and detect visual bugs through interface recognition

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Offer recommendation continuously across sessions; level production and testing in flow, with bots playing each level thousands of times before release.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: King's AI Labs and the game teams, with designers keeping final validation on the levels.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The player's buying and progression behavior (cards or boosters owned, proximity to a goal, purchase frequency). Without fresh behavioral data, the offer recommendation loses relevance and take rate drops.

etapes.detail: AI bots play each level thousands of times to measure difficulty and friction; BAIT detects visual bugs.
Designers read the AI metrics, annotate good and bad examples, and decide whether to adjust.
The attention-based model predicts, per player, the bundle with the highest conversion propensity.
The store serves the offer; click rate, take rate, diversity, and feedback loops are monitored.

prerequis_orga: data science team to maintain and monitor the models
design validation process for the levels
monitoring of feedback loops and diversity
replication.premiere_etape: Instrument player inventory and progression in fine detail, then test an offer-propensity model on a segment before generalizing.

playbook.action: Instrument purchase events, inventory, and progression per player in fine detail
Build a first offer-propensity model and evaluate it offline
playbook.livrable: Trained model with offline accuracy metrics

playbook.action: Run an A/B test on a player segment against static offers
playbook.livrable: Measured lift in click rate and take rate

playbook.action: Generalize and set up monitoring (degenerate feedback loops, offer diversity)
playbook.livrable: Recommendation in production with continuous monitoring and alerting

replication.equipe: 2 data scientists + 1 data engineer + 1 LiveOps PM

statut_vivant.note: Candy Crush Saga remains a top-grossing game in continuous production. The offer recommendation paper dates from 2024 and the use of AI in level design is confirmed the same year by the AI Labs director.

transposable_ue.note: Offer recommendation relies on profiling the player's buying and progression behavior. Under GDPR, profiling for monetization purposes requires a legal basis and transparency. Personalization of offers and prices remains under consumer law scrutiny. The pattern is transposable, with a legal framing.
